items:
Before using a blower for cleaning 
from dust, wear your breathing mask to protect lung 
tissues from the dust particulate.

Don't burn the cloth used in cleaning, collect it and send to 
the dump.
Safety helmet, shoes.

Gas detector
 and vacuum cleaner

The spring washers, split pins and tap washers of any screwed joint opened for 
 maintenance purposes must be replaced.

The same applies to all seals and gaskets exposed during external metal parts 
 should be lubricated with Tecty1 506 at intervals of 2 to 3 years.

All open breaker parts should be covered to protect them against the ingress 
 of dirt while assembly is in progress. Any switching dust which has settled in 
 the breaker and on the built-in parts during operation should be removed 
 immediately the breaker is opened and any subassemblies have been removed. 
 When this dust is exposed to the air for some time it will absorb moisture and 
 can then only be removed with difficulty.
Gloves should be worn.

Wipe off the dust with a rag or use a vacuum cleaner. Don't disturb the dust 
 unnecessarily. Throw the dust and the rag into a refuse bin as soon as the job 
 is finished.

Check SF6 pressure and, if the values do not tally, test the pressure gauges 
 and check the breaker for leaks.
Read and record the counter reading (where applicable).
Draw off the SF6.

Open one interrupter unit of each breaker pole, check the contacts and replace 
 them if they show signs of severe are erosion, if contact replacement proves to 
 be necessary, open the interrupter 6 units and inspect contacts.
Replace filters.
Refill the SF6
